title: Sonny Styles, David Bailey impress in Combine workouts

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sonny Styles, David Bailey impress in Combine workouts
sources.description: Sonny Styles's play at Ohio State made him one of the top prospects in this year's draft class and his chances of being one of the first names called in April were given another boost with Thursday's performance at the Scouting Combine.
